item.title: Canadian ‘crypto king’ set to represent himself at fraud trial
item.description: Aiden Pleterski was allegedly behind a crypto Ponzi scheme between 2021 and 2022 that resulted in a kidnapping and related criminal charges.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Blockchain.com eyes $500M IPO as crypto capital markets thaw: Report
item.description: The crypto company is seeking a valuation of up to $6 billion, well below its 2022 peak, as recently listed crypto stocks struggle to hold their gains.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: US SEC follows CFTC in staff guidance for crypto
item.description: With the failed cloture vote on the CLARITY Act, the SEC announced updates on how federal securities laws could apply to token issuers, following similar guidance from the CFTC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
item.description: Eligible institutions can pledge Benji-issued fund shares for stablecoin credit lines while keeping the underlying assets in off-exchange custody.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
item.description: Fairshake pledged an initial $30 million on media opposing the Democratic candidate in Ohio’s Senate race in what some see as a repeat of spending by the crypto industry in 2024.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability
item.description: Some stolen assets have been frozen, but Bitget has yet to disclose how much has been recovered as investigators continue to assess a possible North Korea link.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: MiCA focus shifts from rulemaking to supervision, ESMA chair says
item.description: ESMA will focus on CASP resilience, outsourcing and reverse solicitation while pursuing harmonized reporting across national regulators.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Altseason is coming — and traders are more discerning this time
item.description: Altseason is almost here and early signs suggest traders are becoming more selective, with capital flowing into revenue-generating protocols across a number of different narratives.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Strategy buys 1,665 Bitcoin for $143M as BTC stack hits 847,666
item.description: Strategy sold 1.47 million MSTR shares for $246.2 million, using the proceeds for Bitcoin purchases and STRC preferred stock repurchases.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: BTC price eyes best Q3 in nine years: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to start the week amid US-Iran war developments but remains up more than 40% for Q3 ahead of key inflation and jobs data.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals as hacker swaps ETH via THORChain
item.description: Ether withdrawals are scheduled to return Tuesday and USDt on Wednesday as Bitget restores services following last week’s $388 million hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Hong Kong regulators expand financial reporting oversight to licensed crypto firms
item.description: The SFC and AFRC signed a new MoU extending financial reporting, audit and compliance cooperation to licensed virtual asset service providers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Scammers steal $2M in ETH as fake GIWA network fools DYORSWAP
item.description: DYORSWAP said it paid more than 200 ETH in compensation, while Upbit operator Dunamu’s GIWA warned that its mainnet had not launched.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin drops under $83K as liquidity hunting keeps bulls from targeting yearly open
item.description: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in dropping on Monday after US president Donald Trump did not commit to permanently halting strikes on Iran.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $2.4B in biggest inflow week since October 2025
item.description: Daily inflows slowed as Bitcoin pulled back from above $87,100, while Ether and XRP ETFs also attracted fresh capital during the week.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: South Korea weighs crypto market makers after JPYC trades at 4 times peg
item.description: Crypto market making is effectively restricted under South Korea’s manipulation rules, but regulators are reconsidering the approach after a JPYC spiked on Upbit this month.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Vitalik Buterin says Hegotá could be Ethereum’s last ‘normal’ fork
item.description: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin said PeerDAS marked the start of Ethereum’s transition “from being just a blockchain to being something much more powerful.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
item.description: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
item.description: The Zano blockchain has been restarted at the block height that came immediately before Hard Fork 6, which introduced Gateway Addresses.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
item.description: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.

item.title: Australia asks OpenAI, Anthropic chiefs to Senate inquiry on rogue hack: Report

item.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2

item.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
